text: Subject Overview Neurobiology is a second-level discipline under biology, its main research contents include neuroscience and related biology research fields. It covers all aspects of neurosurgery, neurosurgery, neurosurgery, neuroanatomy and experimental research of neuroscience, and is an important subject of great concern to the current neuroscience. Neurobiology is the science of the nervous system of human and animals, from molecular and cellular level it to the neural network studying the nervous system, and even the whole system level especially the organization and function of the brain and their mutual relations, to study the growth and development of the nervous system, the ultimate goal is the neural mechanism of behavior and mental activity; At the same time, it provides a scientific basis for elucidating the major issue of how physical movements produce spiritual activities. The development of neurobiology will certainly provide scientific principles and possible ways for human beings to overcome various neurological and mental diseases, and create conditions for the development and utilization of human intelligence. At the same time, it will also vigorously promote the development of artificial neural network, artificial intelligence science and information industry. The development of neurobiology will undoubtedly help solve the problems of the aging of human society in the 21st century. Duration 3 years
